items.t: Was a listed sponsor of SJR 2008, a joint resolution supporting devolution of power from the United States department of education to the states.
items.q: A joint resolution supporting devolution of power from the United States department of education to the states.

record.t: Gaveled in the Iowa Senate on the first day of the Second Regular Session of the 91st General Assembly.
record.q: Monday, January 12, marked the first day of the Second Regular Session of the 91st General Assembly. It was my honor to gavel in the Iowa Senate.

record.t: Was elected President of the Iowa Senate by fellow senators in 2023 and continues to hold the post.
record.q: when they elected her to the position of President of the Senate in 2023, a position she continues to hold.

record.t: Was first elected to the Iowa Senate in 2012.
record.q: Senator Sinclair was first elected to the Iowa Senate in 2012.

record.t: Serves as vice chair of the Rules and Administration Committee.
record.q: She currently serves as the vice chair of the Rules and Administration Committee.

record.t: Served two terms on the Wayne County Board of Supervisors and held leadership roles in county and local communities.
record.q: During two terms on the Wayne County Board of Supervisors, Senator Sinclair held numerous leadership opportunities in our county and local communities
